fullPassage: Kivetz, Urminsky, and Zheng partnered with a café to test the motivating effect of illusory progress in an experiment. Customers received a reward card that offered one free coffee after they'd bought ten. While half of the customers received a card with ten open slots, the other half got a card with twelve open slots. Yet the twelve-slot card had two preexisting "bonus" stamps, so, strictly speaking, these were identical reward programs. Every customer who got a card needed to make ten coffee purchases (and collect ten stamps) to get their free coffee. But the appeal of the free stamps was high. People who thought they'd gotten a head start came back to the café more often, filling in their reward card more quickly than the others. When the card came with two out of twelve slots already filled, it felt to customers like they were already 16 percent finished with the goal before they'd even started. Believing they were closer to the reward, they were more motivated to reach the finish line.

❌ ④ 온라인 설문 조사: 연구자들은 카페와 협력해 실험했으므로 불일치
det.tip: preexisting bonus stamps → 결국 둘 다 10번 구매 = identical

ch: 열 칸 카드를 받은 고객은 아홉 번만 구매해도 무료 커피를 받을 수 있었다.
열두 칸 카드의 보너스 도장은 고객이 첫 방문 때 직접 찍은 것이었다.
두 종류의 카드는 엄밀히 말해 동일한 보상 프로그램이었다.
연구자들은 온라인 설문 조사를 통해 실험을 진행했다.

questions.passage: Kivetz, Urminsky, and Zheng partnered with a café to test the motivating effect of illusory progress in an experiment. Customers received a reward card that offered one free coffee after they'd bought ten. While half of the customers received a card with ten open slots, the other half got a card with twelve open slots. Yet the twelve-slot card had two preexisting "bonus" stamps, so, strictly speaking, these were identical reward programs. Every customer who got a card needed to make ten coffee purchases (and collect ten stamps) to get their free coffee. But the appeal of the free stamps was high. People who thought they'd gotten a head start came back to the café more often, filling in their reward card more quickly than the others. When the card came with two out of twelve slots already filled, it felt to customers like they were already 16 percent finished with the goal before they'd even started. Believing they were closer to the reward, they were more motivated to reach the finish line.
questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: 원문: Believing they were closer to the reward, they were more motivated — 보상에 가까워졌다고 믿어 동기가 '더 높아짐'
det.analysis:
✅ ① 카페와 협력해 가상 진전의 동기 효과 검증: 첫 문장과 일치
✅ ② 절반은 열 칸, 절반은 열두 칸 카드: 세 번째 문장과 일치
✅ ③ 유리한 출발을 믿은 사람들이 카드를 더 빨리 채움: 일곱 번째 문장과 일치
❌ ④ 동기가 오히려 약해졌다: 보상에 더 가까워졌다고 믿어 동기가 '더 높아졌으므로' 불일치 ←정답
det.tip: closer to the reward → more motivated (동기 상승)

ch: 연구자들은 가상의 진전이 주는 동기 부여 효과를 알아보기 위해 카페와 협력했다.
고객의 절반은 열 칸짜리 카드를, 나머지 절반은 열두 칸짜리 카드를 받았다.
유리하게 출발했다고 생각한 사람들은 남들보다 카드를 더 빨리 채웠다.
열두 칸 카드를 받은 고객들은 목표를 향한 동기가 오히려 약해졌다.

det.korean: 요지: 실제 조건이 같아도 '더 가까워졌다'는 믿음 자체가 동기를 높인다 — Believing they were closer to the reward, they were more motivated
det.analysis:
✅ ① 목표에 가까워졌다는 믿음이 의욕을 높인다: 보너스 도장으로 앞서 있다고 믿은 고객들이 더 자주 방문해 카드를 더 빨리 채웠다는 실험 결과와 일치 ←정답
